text:
alex_p: Hey team, quick check — cloud partner wants a single consolidated deliverable pack for marketplace onboarding. What exact security artifacts do we accept? SOC2 / pen tests / questionnaires / infra diagrams? 

mari: For marketplace we need: 1) SOC2 Type II attestation (pdf) + summary; 2) Pen test executive summary + remediation plan; 3) completed vendor questionnaire (signed); 4) redacted evidence bundle (logs/configs) via presigned S3; expiration on evidences = 12 months. :memo:

karim: For HW partners add firmware attestations + HSM key management doc. Some partners will only provide SOC3 public report — is that ok? 

dan: SOC3 by itself isn't sufficient. We need SOC2 attestation or a letter from partner + evidence mapping. If partner is large vendor (e.g., AcmeHV) we can accept a SOC3 + signed mapping doc. 

julia: Storage/retention question — where should partners upload? We prefer the marketplace-evidence bucket with object path `partners/<partner>/onboard/<timestamp>/` and presign TTL 72h. Also require metadata json alongside each upload. 

marketplace-audits: Required metadata: `partner_name`, `report_type`, `report_period_start`, `report_period_end`, `is_redacted` (true/false). We'll validate on ingest. 

alex_p: Thanks. Can someone own coordinating the pen-test artifact redaction and the mapping doc? I can ping partner but need internal owners. 

mari: I'll own SOC + questionnaire intake. 

karim: I'll take HW attestation + HSM docs. 

dan: I'll review pen-test exec summary + remediation mapping with security. 

sre-bot: presign link created: https://s3.redwood-inference.example/presign/partners/acme/1791122337 - expires in 72h. :robot_face: 

julia: FYI for the ingestion playbook, use this presign CLI snippet: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/partners/acme/1791122337/report.pdf --expires-in 259200
```

alex_p: Great — timeline: partner says they want listing by EOD next Tues. Can we commit to collecting artifacts by Friday? 

dan: Friday is tight but doable if partner responds today. I'll coordinate with security for fast triage. 

mari: I'll send questionnaire + upload instructions now. 

karim: Also flagging firmware bits may need NDA permissions — I'll clarify with legal. 

alex_p: Awesome. I'll update partner and link them to presign. Thanks all :raised_hands:
